section.p: Consider a "Backup the Production Database" chapter in a "Database Maintenance Guide" document where you want to correctly place the <stepresult> in the task topic.
section.codeblock:
Create a full backup of the production database to an external storage location.

Confirm that you have the db_backup role and sufficient disk space on the target storage.

Stop non-critical batch jobs that write to the database.

Batch jobs are stopped and no write locks remain.

Run the backup command: pg_dump -Fc --file=/backups/prod-db.bak prod_db .

A compressed backup file named /backups/prod-db.bak is created.

You have a verified full backup stored on the external storage and logs showing completion time.
section.p: Result: Place transient, step-specific verification messages in <stepresult> immediately after the step that produces them.
